# apicp_totp (Resource)

Enables TOTP-gated token issuance for an `apicp_account` (PLAN.md §8 phase 10) - apicp generates the secret server-side. `secret`/`otpauth_url` are only known immediately after the `terraform apply` that creates this resource; apicp never returns the secret again after that (it reads back as unknown, not empty, after an import or a refresh of an existing resource) - re-enrolling (e.g. to reset a lost authenticator) means tainting and recreating this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apicp_account" "example" {
  name = "Example Reseller"
  tier = "reseller"
}

resource "apicp_totp" "example" {
  account_id = apicp_account.example.id
}

output "totp_otpauth_url" {
  value     = apicp_totp.example.otpauth_url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) ID of the `apicp_account` to enroll. Changing this replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same value as `account_id` - apicp has at most one TOTP enrollment per account.
- `otpauth_url` (String, Sensitive) otpauth:// URL an authenticator app can import directly (encodes the same secret) - render this as a QR code yourself if needed, apicp doesn't generate one.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Base32 TOTP secret. Only populated in the apply that creates this resource - see the resource description.
